title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Company Description

With 18 years of experience in technology, DEVELL has delved into the field of Generative Artificial Intelligence since its inception, positioning itself as a significant player in a market full of endless possibilities. Our deep understanding and practical application of Generative AI make us the ideal partner for companies looking to explore and maximize the potential of this revolutionary technology. At DEVELL, we convert emerging opportunities into tangible solutions that drive innovation and growth.


Role Description

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (TypeScript) to join our growing engineering team. You will work on high-impact projects, contributing to front-end and back-end solutions that demand scalability, maintainability, and architectural elegance.


This is not just about coding – we want someone who can design abstract solutions, implement complex features, and influence technical decisions that shape our platform for years to come.


Responsibilities

  • ⁠Architect, design, and implement scalable full-stack applications using TypeScript.
  • Build and maintain back-end services with NestJS.
  • Contribute to front-end development using at least two frameworks among Angular, React, Svelte, or Vue.
  • ⁠Design modular and abstract solutions that reduce complexity and improve maintainability across projects.
  • ⁠Collaborate with cross-functional teams (AI, product, design, and infrastructure) to deliver robust solutions.
  • Review code, mentor peers, and promote best practices in software engineering.
  • Take ownership of complex features from concept to production.


Qualifications

  • ⁠Mandatory: Strong proficiency in TypeScript.
  • Mandatory: Proven experience with NestJS.
  • Mandatory: Experience in at least two front-end frameworks among Angular, React, Svelte, Vue.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture patterns (DI, modularization, micro frontends, event-driven, etc.).
  • Experience building and maintaining complex, scalable systems.
  • Strong grasp of CSS, HTML5, responsive design, and UI performance optimization.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to collaborate in remote-first teams.
  • A mindset for clean code, testing, and maintainability.


Nice to Have

  • ⁠Experience with microservices or event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • ⁠Knowledge of design systems and component-driven development.
  • Experience with AI-powered applications.
  • Experience managing internal packages using private registries (npm, Verdaccio, GitLab, etc.).
  • ⁠Hands-on experience with bundlers (Webpack, Vite, esbuild, Nx).

title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
Senior Flutter Developer

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level: Senior


We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms , real-time presence , audio/video (WebRTC) , chat , screen sharing , collaborative boards , and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Flutter Developer focused on macOS Desktop to build and evolve our desktop client. You’ll ship a high-performance, stable, and well-instrumented app that integrates video/audio, real-time features, and collaborative tools—while keeping top-tier code quality, testing, and documentation.

Secondary scope: help maintain Android and iOS builds (feature parity, fixes, and releases).


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain the Flutter macOS app with clean architecture, modular layers, and reliable state management .
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and real-time services (e.g., WebSockets/Streams ).
  • Implement A/V features (e.g., flutter_webrtc): device selection, camera/mic permissions, I/O routing, and stability under variable networks.
  • Ensure observability end to end: instrument product events/metrics; triage errors with Sentry ; capture UX signals with Microsoft Clarity (session replay/heatmaps) where applicable (web/embedded views); analyze performance traces and dashboards.
  • Own quality : unit, widget, and integration tests; CI checks; code reviews; technical docs.
  • Handle macOS distribution : code signing & notarization , entitlements, Hardened Runtime , App Sandbox , Keychain; package DMG/PKG ; manage auto-update (e.g., Sparkle).
  • Collaborate with Product/Design/QA to refine requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria; keep specs tidy in Confluence and PRs clear.
  • Team rituals & reporting:
  • Attend daily standups in English and other ceremonies (planning, grooming, demos, retros).
  • Keep Jira up to date (status, links, attachments) and log time entries (work logs) per task.
  • Submit an end-of-day (EOD) daily report in English including: hours worked (per task), what was completed, current task & ETA, blockers, and plan for tomorrow.
  • Secondary (Android & iOS): maintain parity when applicable, fix platform-specific issues, help with CI/CD and store releases , monitor crashes/perf via Sentry and review UX insights with Clarity when relevant.


CPU & GPU Optimizations (primary focus)

CPU

  • Minimize rebuilds: effective state selection (BLoC/Riverpod/Provider), const constructors, proper Keys , split large widgets.
  • Cut redundant layout/work: avoid heavy logic in build, cache computed values, reduce intrinsic measurements, coalesce events, debounce/throttle streams.
  • Move heavy tasks off the UI thread: isolates (compute/custom), lazy JSON parsing, incremental work units.
  • Frame scheduling discipline: prevent setState loops; render only when state actually changes.

GPU

  • Reduce overdraw/repaints : place RepaintBoundary wisely; optimize CustomPainter (shouldRepaint); avoid large Opacity on complex subtrees.
  • Avoid expensive effects: minimize saveLayer , heavy blurs/gradients and big shadows .
  • Use right-sized images & filterQuality (low/none when acceptable); limit transforms on large layers.
  • Shader jank control: warm up shaders / capture SkSL where applicable; keep fragment shaders simple.
  • Pause/disable animations when off-screen; keep animation count/area minimal.


Measurement & Guardrails:

  • Profile with Flutter DevTools (CPU/GPU/frame timeline) and add perf budgets (avg CPU%/GPU frame time) to CI gates.
  • Track before/after metrics per feature; regressions must be fixed before release.


Must-Haves

  • Hands-on with RESTful APIs , WebSockets/Streams , async/isolates , and robust error handling.

description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Mainframe - Analista de Sustentação Sênior


Estamos em busca de profissionais sêniores em sustentação de sistemas Mainframe para atuar em ambiente corporativo de grande porte. O profissional integrará uma squad ágil, em modelo remoto, participando ativamente de rituais semanais, mensais e diários junto ao cliente.

O foco da posição é a sustentação de aplicações críticas em ambiente z/OS, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade operacional e tratamento de incidentes, dentro dos SLAs estabelecidos.


Responsabilidades

Analisar, classificar, priorizar e tratar incidentes em ambiente Mainframe (N1, N2, N3);

Executar e monitorar jobs, JCLs, execuções, amarrações e tratamento de abends;

Realizar correções em sistemas legados garantindo a rastreabilidade via ServiceNow;

Apoiar processos de change management, incluindo planejamento e execução de deploys em ambientes de homologação e produção;

Interagir com o Product Owner e equipes de negócio para esclarecer demandas e priorizações;

Participar dos rituais ágeis (dailies, weeklies, reviews, retrospectivas);

Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de sustentação e para a capacitação do time.


Requisitos Técnicos

Obrigatórios:

Experiência sólida em Mainframe (z/OS) com COBOL, DB2, JCL, CICS, VSAM, Control-M;

Atuação comprovada em sustentação de ambientes críticos e de alta volumetria de incidentes;

Vivência em ferramentas ITSM (ServiceNow), gestão de incidentes e SLAs;

Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Diferencial:

Conhecimento em integração de sistemas Mainframe com APIs e SQL Server;

Experiência em processos de deploy e pipelines automatizados (ex.: Azure DevOps, Jenkins).


Remoto (com possibilidade de reuniões presenciais pontuais - Curitiba/PR - ).

title: Bolsista Doutor - BCS SISTEMAS - Estimular o uso do smartphone no dia a dia no comércio varejista | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Inovar o varejo por meio da tecnologia é o que impulsiona a BCS SISTEMAS, e você pode ser parte dessa transformação. Estamos em busca de talentos criativos, proativos e estratégicos para integrar um projeto que visa desenvolver soluções móveis inteligentes, promovendo o uso efetivo de smartphones no dia a dia das operações do comércio varejista.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar desde o mapeamento de processos e pesquisa de campo com lojistas e usuários do ERP, até a prototipação, desenvolvimento, integração e validação de aplicativos com tecnologias como nuvem, banco de dados, inteligência artificial, dashboards e notificações — tudo conectado ao ecossistema do nosso ERP.

Se você gosta de aliar tecnologia à experiência do usuário, tem familiaridade com soluções móveis e deseja causar impacto real em um setor essencial da economia, essa vaga é para você.


Formação Acadêmica:


Doutorado completo Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Análise de Sistemas, Sistemas da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Dados, Tecnologia ou áreas afins.


Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Projeto: Estimular o uso do smartphone no dia a dia no comércio varejista.


Principais Atividades:

  • Mapeamento de Processos Operacionais no Varejo
  • Pesquisa de Campo com Lojistas e Usuários do ERP
  • Prototipação de Soluções Móveis
  • Desenvolvimento e Integração com o ERP
  • Validação em Campo e Iterações de Produto
  • Planejamento de Escalonamento e Estratégia de Adoção
  • Avaliação de Impacto e Documentação Técnica
  • Transferência de Conhecimento e Capacitação Interna


Conhecimento necessário:

  • Desenvolvimento de Aplicativos Móveis
  • UX/UI Design para Mobilidade


Conhecimento desejável:

  • Pesquisa Aplicada e Validação de Soluções em Campo
  • Gestão da Inovação e Desenvolvimento de Produtos
  • Análise de Dados e Tomada de Decisão
  • Cloud


Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho : Remoto

Necessário disponibilidade para viagem

Local: Londrina - PR


Soft Skills : Trabalho em equipe; Autonomia; Criatividade; Organização; Ética e responsabilidade.

title: Calypso Back Office Business Analyst
description:
Why Join Qaracter


Qaracter is an international consulting firm specialized in the financial and banking sector. We partner with leading institutions to drive transformation projects across compliance, technology, operations, and risk management.


With a global mindset and strong expertise in financial services, we help our clients face complex challenges and design innovative solutions.


What powers it all? Our people — ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.



What You’ll Do


  • Support and configure Calypso back office modules (settlements, payments, accounting)
  • Assist with Calypso platform upgrades and system workflows
  • Maintain SDI data and ensure operational efficiency
  • Collaborate with global teams to address technical queries



What You Bring


  • 8+ years in financial services with 3+ years using Calypso
  • Strong Calypso back office experience
  • Solid understanding of MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Computer Science, or Engineering
  • Strong problem-solving and adaptability in fast-paced environments



Location


  • LATAM (Remote).



Your Benefits at Qaracter


  • Opportunity to work on international financial projects.
  • Flexibility: remote, hybrid, or in-office options depending on the client.
  • Recognition and referral programs.
  • Ongoing learning and training opportunities with reimbursement options.
  • Well-being program and team events.
  • Competitive compensation and top-tier equipment provision.



At QARACTER Group, we are committed to ensuring equal opportunities and non-discrimination in all our processes, promoting an inclusive and diverse work environment. All applications are welcome regardless of sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, origin, ethnicity, age, disability, or any other personal or social condition, in line with our Plan de Igualdad and our commitment to equity.

title: Agente de Retenção – Chat
description:
Descrição do Cargo

O Agente de Retenção – Chat é responsável pelo atendimento receptivo de clientes que solicitam a exclusão de suas contas na plataforma. Esse profissional atua com foco em retenção, buscando compreender os motivos da solicitação, oferecer soluções alternativas e incentivar a permanência do cliente. Quando a exclusão for mantida, o agente deve garantir que o processo seja conduzido com clareza, agilidade e respeito, assegurando uma experiência positiva até o encerramento da relação.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

● Atender clientes via chat de forma receptiva, compreendendo os motivos da solicitação de exclusão.

● Atuar de maneira proativa na tentativa de retenção, oferecendo soluções adequadas como ajustes de limites, pausas temporárias ou encaminhamento a áreas especializadas.

● Explicar de forma escrita, clara e objetiva os impactos da exclusão, apresentando alternativas viáveis.

● Garantir comunicação cordial, empática e profissional, adaptada ao tom de texto.

● Quando a exclusão for mantida, orientar o cliente sobre o procedimento correto na plataforma.

● Registrar com precisão todos os atendimentos, incluindo os motivos de exclusão e tentativas de retenção.

● Reportar insights e feedbacks recorrentes para contribuir com a melhoria contínua da experiência do cliente.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

● Ensino médio completo ou em andamento.

● Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência em atendimento ao cliente, preferencialmente em canais digitais (chat, e-mail, redes sociais).

● Excelente comunicação escrita, com domínio da norma culta da língua portuguesa.

● Habilidade de negociação e persuasão para retenção de clientes.

● Capacidade de lidar com múltiplos atendimentos simultâneos.

● Conhecimento básico de sistemas de atendimento (Zendesk, CRM, chats).


Diferenciais:

● Vivência com plataformas como Zendesk, Jira e Slack.

● Experiência em retenção de clientes ou em processos de cancelamento.

● Conhecimento em comunicação assertiva e atendimento humanizado.

● Familiaridade com sistemas de atendimento e CRM.


Benefícios:

  • Vale-alimentação
  • Auxílio home office

title: Professor de alemão
description:
Vaga para Professor de Alemão (REMOTO)


Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um professor de alemão qualificado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe de ensino online no Instituto Stephanie Lich. Se você é um profissional experiente em ensino online, organizado, atento às demandas específicas de cada aluno, e busca uma oportunidade em uma instituição que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo e oferece suporte constante ao professor, essa vaga é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade: Flexibilidade de horário, para atender à crescente demanda de alunos que chegam de forma orgânica por meio das nossas redes e marketing e parcerias.


  • Experiência e Flexibilidade: Experiência comprovada no ensino remoto de alemão e experiência e flexibilidade para utilizar diversoso materiais didáticos em sala de aula.


  • Habilidades Tecnológicas: Domínio de plataformas de ensino online, como salas de aula virtuais com lousa digital e aplicativos complementares. O pleno domínio do Google Meet é imprescindível.


  • Comunicação: Ter uma boa comunicação, tanto com os alunos quanto com a parte administrativa do Instituto.


Competências


  • Capacidade de planejar e conduzir aulas interativas e envolventes, usando diversas ferramentas tecnológicas para otimizar o aprendizado.


  • É fundamental atenção às demandas e necessidades dos alunos em prol de garantir um ensino personalizado e eficaz.


Oferecemos:

Remuneração Competitiva: Uma hora-aula de R$ 40,00 atrativa e alinhada com o mercado, comparável às demais escolas de idiomas.


Suporte ao Professor: Fornecemos todo o suporte necessário, incluindo um convênio Google para utilizações de ferramentes pagas pelo Instituto, materiais didáticos atualizados para facilitar o processo de ensino e um material didático próprio do Instituto.


Ambiente de Trabalho: Um ambiente colaborativo e de apoio, onde valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos professores e incentivamos o aprimoramento constante.


Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e, juntos, proporcionar uma experiência de aprendizado única para nossos alunos!

title: Gerente de logística de transporte
description:
Principais Atividades:

• Planejamento e controle de fretes para transporte de grãos e adubo

• Contato com motoristas e transportadoras

• Fechar contratos

• Contato com motoristas e transportadoras

• Emissão de documentos de transporte (CT-e, MDF-e, etc.)

• Acompanhamento de carregamentos, roteiros e entregas

• Controle de prazos, pesagens, notas fiscais e comprovantes

• Resolução de ocorrências de transporte e suporte ao time operacional

• Atualização de planilhas e sistemas logísticos

Conhecimento em processos de BID (cotação eletrônica de fretes/negociação com transportadoras);

Habilidade em análise de custos e indicadores logísticos;


Requisitos:

• Ensino médio completo (desejável curso técnico ou superior em Logística, Administração, ou áreas afins)

• Experiência com logística de fretes

• Conhecimento em emissão de CT-e, MDF-e e documentos fiscais

• Domínio básico de Excel e sistemas de gestão logística

• Organização, agilidade e boa comunicação

title: BD(Recruited Agencies)
description:
Corporate Information

TRANSSNET Group is a joint venture company established by China's leading Internet company NetEase Group (NASDAQ: NTES) and TRANSSION Holdings Group, a global provider of smart terminal products and mobile value-added services. TRANSSNET combines NetEase’s strong technical strength and advanced Internet product operation concepts with TRANSSION’s mature channel resources and solid market foundation in Africa, becoming one of the leading Internet companies serving the most users in Africa with excellent online applications from Boomplay, the largest online music platform in Africa, to TalkTalk and SOYO, both extraordinary social apps, to mobile games.


This position will serve the social app(SOYO) business unit.


Job Requirements:

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • At least one year of experience in agency recruitment or management.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to make friends with users.
  • Sales-oriented mindset with patience.
  • Enjoy using voice social apps, familiar with various features and gameplay.
  • Reliable and loyal, with integrity and a goal-oriented approach.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for recruiting agencies and hosts (at least 200-300 hosts per month)
  • Assist in the translation of events and product features (English to Portuguese)

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
What You’ll Do

As part of our talent acquisition team, you are charged with finding top talent. You’re responsible for guiding candidates through our recruiting process and partnering with hiring leaders to help build their teams. You are enthusiastic and driven, which allows you to develop meaning relationships. You are systems savvy and passionate about improving our recruiting process.


We are looking for a Recruiter with experience identifying top talent for niche positions across different verticals. The ideal candidate demonstrates their expertise by sharing recruiting best practices, engaging highly skilled talent while setting time to fill expectations based on data. He/she is organized, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is a strong communicator.


Please submit your resume in English. Applications in other languages cannot be considered.


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Partner with Hiring Leaders to develop a complete understanding of each opening.
  • Manage the entire recruiting life cycle from candidate generation through direct sourcing, interviewing, salary negotiations, job file maintenance, offer extension and closing candidates.
  • Identify passive candidates using intricate Boolean searches, user groups, professional and social networking, candidate referrals, networking, and our ATS
  • Be passionate about social media and savvy internet research
  • Pipeline candidates and identify what future opportunities they may be a fit for
  • Focus & lead on Diversity identification, sourcing, and attraction
  • Proactively research and generate new/creative sourcing ideas for filling challenging positions by using knowledge of current sourcing practices and trends
  • Establish and maintain positive relationships with candidates and hiring leaders throughout the recruiting lifecycle


What You'll Need to be Successful

  • Approximately 6+ years of proven experience as a technical recruiter, with a strong track record of sourcing and closing talent in engineering and product roles.
  • In-house recruiting experience, ideally within tech/SaaS environments
  • Proven track record managing full-cycle recruitment: kick-off calls, job postings, sourcing, screening, assessments, interview coordination, and offer management
  • Excellent written and spoken English

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Remoto
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

Na Barte, não somos apenas uma fintech; somos arquitetos da inovação  e desbravadores no universo dos pagamentos B2B. Fundada em 2021, nascemos com a missão audaciosa de transformar o cenário financeiro para médias e grandes empresas brasileiras, tornando o complexo simples e o demorado, instantâneo.


Imagine um mundo onde o departamento financeiro opera com fluidez, sem burocracia e com total autonomia. Se você é um talento apaixonado por tecnologia, que busca desafios significativos e quer deixar sua marca em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, a Barte é o seu lugar. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e nos ajude a redesenhar o futuro dos pagamentos empresariais no Brasil!

  • Software Engineer (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior, Tech Lead)
  • Engenheiro de Qualidade (Pleno ou Sênior)

title: Java Fullstack Developer SR
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home



Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Java Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both front-end and back-end development, with a passion for building scalable and efficient applications. As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance web applications that meet the needs of our clients and stakeholders.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Development of new features;
  • Maintenance of existing applications;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Implement solution from coding to testing to production deployment support;
  • Perform code reviews.


Essential Skills

  • Proficiency in Backend Java and Java Spring Boot;
  • Experience with automated testing in Java (e.g. Unit Test, Integration Test, etc.);
  • Solid experience with Python;
  • Solid Front-end development experience, especially with React (or any other SPA)
  • Experience with Typescript;
  • Experience with Microservices Architecture;
  • Experience with modeling, producing and consuming web services-based APIs (RESTful or SOAP based);
  • Experience using AWS services;
  • Good knowledge on relational and non-relational databases, be able to work with Postgres and MongoDB;
  • Practical understanding of Git or similar VCS, CI/CD practices, with a preference for GitHub Actions or Jenkins;
  • Good communication skills in English.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with GraphQL;
  • Experience with agile development;
  • Familiarity with Message Brokers (RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS, etc);
  • Utilization of monitoring tools such as Sumo Logic, New Relic, Datadog, or equivalent solutions for troubleshooting and logging;


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: UX Designer Pleno
description:
A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para UX Designer Pleno para se juntar ao nosso time multidisciplinar na diretoria do SINACOR. A equipe atua com as disciplinas de UX (incluindo UI) e frontend de forma cross, atendendo várias squads de desenvolvimento e tendo interação com PMs, POs e desenvolvedores.


Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir pesquisas com usuários, incluindo entrevistas, observação, testes de usabilidade e análises quantitativas e qualitativas, traduzindo insights em oportunidades de melhoria significativas.
  • Mapear fluxos e jornadas do usuário, identificando pontos de fricção e propondo soluções eficazes e alinhadas com o negócio.
  • Criar wireframes, protótipos de baixa e alta fidelidade e especificações funcionais, utilizando sua expertise em ferramentas como Figma.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com desenvolvedores frontend para garantir a consistência visual e a aderência às diretrizes de design, criando soluções que sejam viáveis do ponto de vista de design e de tecnologia.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões de alinhamento com stakeholders, defendendo uma abordagem centrada no usuário.
  • Validar soluções por meio de testes, iterando com base em feedbacks para aprimorar continuamente as experiências.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências, ferramentas e melhores práticas de UX, contribuindo para a evolução do nosso time.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como UX Designer, com um mínimo de 3 anos de atuação na área.
  • Domínio da ferramenta Figma.
  • Sólido conhecimento em métodos de pesquisa e avaliação de usabilidade.
  • Experiência na criação de fluxos, wireframes e protótipos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diversos stakeholders em um ambiente ágil.
  • Visão sistêmica e habilidade de equilibrar as necessidades do usuário com os objetivos de negócio.

Soft Skills:

  • Empatia: Capacidade de compreender e se conectar com as necessidades e emoções dos usuários para criar soluções que realmente ressoem com eles.
  • Criatividade: Habilidade de pensar fora da caixa e propor soluções inovadoras para problemas complexos de design.
  • Pensamento Crítico: Capacidade de analisar informações de forma objetiva e tomar decisões fundamentadas que beneficiem tanto os usuários quanto os objetivos do negócio.
  • Adaptabilidade: Flexibilidade para se ajustar a mudanças e novos desafios em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução.
  • Colaboração: Habilidade de trabalhar efetivamente em equipe, promovendo um ambiente de apoio e troca de ideias.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em UI design e experiência com Design System.
  • Noções de acessibilidade digital (WCAG).
  • Vivência em projetos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência no mercado financeiro é um diferencial que valorizamos.

title: Global Feasibility Lead II
description:
Job Overview

The Global Feasibility Lead II will play an integral role in operational strategy and planning in the preaward space through participation in strategy development conversations, robust primary and secondary data collection and analysis, and development of feasibility and site selection strategies. In addition, the Global Feasibility Lead II will be responsible for managing global feasibility projects, working closely with representatives within the company to deliver robust feasibility reports to our customers. The Global Feasibility Lead II will transition the site selection strategy to operations in the post-award space by handing over relevant pre-award findings to the site selection team. The Global Feasibility Lead II will lead and/or contribute to process improvement and change initiatives within Feasibility, alongside training opportunities for departmental requirements and any other subjects that impact on feasibility conduct. The Global Feasibility Lead 2 role requires a diverse skill set; strong data mining and analytics skills, writing and presentation skills, and customer management skills are required. Comfort with participating in and/or leading client facing interactions as it relates to presenting feasibility related findings and recommendations is necessary.


Summary Of Responsibilities

  • Accountable for supporting the development, analyses, interpretation, and presentation of primary and secondary data in support of operational strategy and planning.
  • Conducts data mining of internal and external databases and initiates/oversees the collection of primary data for use in development of robust strategies for global clinical trials (country/site mix, site selection, enrollment modeling.).
  • Participates in the development of proposals and bid defenses; provides recommendations on the most appropriate use of data to support proposals and bid defense presentations, works with the team to identify potential risks, and is learning to propose effective solutions as appropriate.
  • Actively participates on cross-functional teams that plan, analyze, and present proposals and bid defenses as part of winning new business and maintaining client base.
  • Serves as functional bidder reviewer of the budget and text for proposals for which feasibility and/or site identification is included as the primary deliverable.
  • Leads cross functional teams in standalone feasibility efforts; responsible for final report creation and delivery, including discussion of findings and recommendations with external clients.
  • Participates in intra and inter-departmental meetings, leading/contributing to the presentation of information on feasibility offerings, demonstrating continued value-add of the department and providing training on best practices, processes and tools.
  • Develops networking abilities and has an ability/willingness to work with individuals across the globe.
  • Leads and/or contributes to process improvement or special projects within Feasibility.
  • Lead and/or contributes to development, implementation, and maintenance of systems within Feasibility.
  • Contributes to best practice for feasibility conduct.
  • Mentors junior team members (GFL1 or newer GFL2s as needed)
  • And all other duties as needed or assigned.


Qualifications (Minimum Required)

  • Associate degree with equivalent work experience.
  • Practical experience and understanding of global drug development and clinical trials including demonstrated experience for the mining, manipulating, and presenting of complex scientific data as it relates to clinical research and market analyses.


Experience (Minimum Required)

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

Learn more about our EEO & Accommodations request here.

  • Candidates should have at least 4 years of working experience in an academic, science/health-related industry and at least 2 years of relevant experience in clinical research or a science/health-related industry. An associate degree is required; a master’s degree in a science-related discipline is preferred.
  • Position specific requirements:
  • Strong data mining and analytical skills.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills.
  • Upholds the highest standard of personal professionalism and work integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong attention to detail/quality control skills.
  • Ability to successfully and quickly understand scientific information so as to be able to independently source data/information relevant to a scientific/medical strategy.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, management, operations staff, clients, and executive management.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities effectively.
  • Negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in analyzing study and investigator performance metrics.
  • Self-motivated, works effectively under pressure.
  • Technical Requirements:
  • Excellent computer skills, including strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and other data capture and compilation tools.
  • Established knowledge of tools used in obtaining critical market analyses of therapeutic pipelines.
  • Strong skills in scientific data manipulation, analysis, reporting, and maintenance.
  • Proven written and verbal communication skills, with strengths in independently gathering/presenting data in support of operational strategy and planning.

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation , and AI/LLM Quality Assurance . The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations , and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience in AI red teaming , LLM safety testing, or adversarial prompt design.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering , NLP tasks, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
  • Strong background in Quality Assurance , content review, or test case development for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.
  • Experience in risk assessment, red team security testing, or AI policy & governance.

Background in linguistics, psychology, or computational ethics is a plus.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test


Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.


If interested, kindly share your resume at:

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP MM/DRC- S/4HANA,Remote mode who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Must Have

Functional experience with SAP MM, integration with other application, Brazilian SAP Localization knowledge, NFe knowledge and enhancements to supply processes specially with SAP DRC, Experience with Project, Upgrade, Implementation and Rollout Projects. Experience with SAP DRC inbound.


Good to Have

Experience working with multiple teams in different regions.

Experience with SAP DRC outbound.

SAP S/4HANA Rise experience.

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for work in Blueprint requitements, back to standard on SAP Localization main topics for Brazil, SAP Customizing/Settings, SAP Notes support to Basis and ABAP team, Unit testing execution, Business and User Acceptance testing support, Transition of requirements to customer stakeholders, key users training, Hypercare/stabilization support (+7yrs experience).

As a Functional Consultant, will be responsible for resolving any SAP issues reported by the business users and delivering all enhancements and upgrade issues as required by business users.

Lead the end-to-end implementation of SAP DRC NF-e projects, including requirement gathering, configuration, testing, and deployment.

Customize and optimize SAP DRC solutions to ensure seamless electronic invoicing (NF-e) compliance in Brazil or other supported jurisdictions.

Ensure accurate integration of SAP DRC with external systems, including government tax portals and legacy systems.

Provide subject matter expertise on local tax regulations and compliance requirements for e-invoicing.

Identify risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies during the project lifecycle.

Conduct user training, support issue resolution, and provide go-live assistance.

Maintain documentation for processes, configurations, and project changes.

Responsible for completing all tasks assigned by team lead and project manager.

Responsible for reviewing solutions designed by the team members and proposing improvements.

Responsible for proactively working with business users for identifying and resolving recurring issues.

Experience in a Professional Consumers and package (CPG) company is an asset.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Reimbursement of Certifications

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Líder de Projetos SAP SD SR - Reforma tributária - Inglês Avançado/Fluente
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.


✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essa vaga é para você ! ✨

  • Líder de Projetos SAP SD SR - Reforma tributária - Inglês Avançado/Fluente


Sobre a oportunidade:

  • Início: Assim que aprovado
  • Prazo: Indeterminado, fazer parte do time da consultoria
  • Atividades: Liderar e coordenar projetos de Reforma Tributária SAP SD e demais iniciativas estratégicas, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio e prazos
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre delivery e fábrica SAP
  • Apoiar equipes multidisciplinares, oferecendo direcionamento, suporte técnico e liderança motivacional
  • Apoiar na priorização e alocação de recursos em cenários de múltiplas demandas concorrentes
  • Realizar a comunicação com áreas de negócio e stakeholders, assegurando entendimento dos impactos, riscos e status dos projetos
  • Garantir a documentação adequada dos projetos, cumprindo com processos de governança e compliance
  • Atuar com agilidade em demandas emergenciais, apoiando soluções críticas quando necessário
  • Participar de fóruns de projetos, planejamento de capacidade e alinhamento estratégico com áreas de negócio


Requisitos:

  • Experiência em projetos de grande porte e abrangência global
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente
  • Conhecimento de processos fiscais, RH ou supply chain em contexto SAP
  • Vivência com gestão de portfólio de projetos e planejamento de capacidade de recursos
  • Conhecimento funcional SAP (Fiscal, RH, Distribuição, Finance, Controladoria, Inbound, Outbound)


Desejável:

  • DRC Outbound


Junte-se a nós e ajude-nos a humanizar o mundo através da tecnologia!

title: Arquiteto de Software Sênior
description:
Posição: Arquiteto de Software Sênior


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar o cenário atual (AS-IS) e definir a visão futura de arquitetura (TO-BE).
  • Definir e documentar padrões de arquitetura, microsserviços e APIs.
  • Projetar infraestrutura cloud (Kubernetes, API Gateway, service mesh).
  • Liderar governança de arquitetura e processos de CI/CD.
  • Garantir atributos de qualidade (segurança, performance, escalabilidade).
  • Atuar como mentor técnico de desenvolvedores e tech leads.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em microsserviços (desenho, implantação, padrões: Saga, CQRS, Circuit Breaker).
  • Domínio de PHP (Symfony) e/ou Java (Spring Boot).
  • Experiência com frontend (preferencialmente Angular) e design de APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Vivência em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Kubernetes como diferencial).
  • Forte conhecimento em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation).


Diferenciais

  • Migração de monólito para microsserviços.
  • Monitoramento/observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, New Relic).
  • Segurança (OWASP, APIs, identity providers).
  • Experiência em EdTech.

description:

  • Analisar o cenário atual (AS-IS) e definir a visão futura de arquitetura (TO-BE).
  • Definir e documentar padrões de arquitetura, microsserviços e APIs.

  • Liderar governança de arquitetura e processos de CI/CD.

  • Experiência com frontend (preferencialmente Angular) e design de APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Vivência em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Kubernetes como diferencial).
  • Forte conhecimento em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation).


Diferenciais

  • Monitoramento/observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, New Relic).

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
A Zoomlion Brasil, multinacional com forte atuação global nos segmentos de máquinas pesadas para construção civil e agricultura, está com processo seletivo aberto para a posição de Gerente de Vendas no Brasil.


Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para profissionais com sólida experiência no setor, perfil de liderança e visão comercial orientada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a equipe nacional de vendas, promovendo o desenvolvimento comercial dos profissionais;
  • Definir estratégias comerciais alinhadas ao posicionamento global da empresa e às demandas do mercado brasileiro;
  • Gerenciar metas, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios de performance;
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão de mercado e novos canais de distribuição;
  • Atuar diretamente na negociação com grandes contas e parceiros estratégicos;
  • Representar a empresa em feiras, eventos e visitas institucionais, mantendo relacionamento próximo com clientes e stakeholders.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo (Administração, Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas);
  • Inglês avançado (interações frequentes com a matriz e equipes globais);
  • Experiência comprovada na função de gerência comercial em empresas do segmento de máquinas pesadas (construção civil e/ou agrícola);
  • Histórico de liderança de equipes comerciais e gestão de territórios nacionais;
  • Conhecimento do mercado brasileiro, canais de distribuição e estratégias de penetração comercial.

title: Gerente Operacional Fulfillment
description:
VAGA HIGH LEVEL


Estamos buscando um profissional com experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de operações de fulfillment em empresas de E-commerce. Domínio TOTAL de SHOPIFY , mente analítica e sede por resultado!


Necessário:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em sistemas de gestão de armazém e otimização das operações para garantir a velocidade de processamento de pedidos na Shopify .
  • Capacidade demonstrada em gerenciamento de equipes, flexibilidade , adaptabilidade e interligação com as áreas de compras no gerenciamento de estoque;
  • Conhecimentos em análise de dados e uso de indicadores para medição do desempenho e identificação de áreas de melhoria;
  • Liderança, comunicação efetiva e habilidades de tomada de decisão são qualidades essenciais para o cargo.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar as operações de fulfillment, garantindo a eficiência e eficácia no processamento e rápida entrega dos pedidos;
  • Implementar e gerenciar sistemas de gestão dos armazéns na Europa para otimizar as operações e reduzir os custos;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de compras para garantir a gestão eficiente do estoque;
  • Analisar dados e indicadores para identificar tendências, problemas e oportunidades de melhoria, agilizando o processo operacional interno , direcionando gestores de Armazéns e garantindo entrega rápida para nossos clientes;
  • Desenvolver e implementar processos e procedimentos para garantir a qualidade e a segurança nas operações de logística e fulfillment.


PERFORMANCE TEM PREÇO. E AQUI É ALTO!


SALARIO FIXO + BÔNUS POR PERFORMANCE . Podendo chegar a R$100 MIL POR MÊS por aumento da Taxa de Entrega.

title: AI Gateway Engineer
description:
AI Gateway Engineer

We are seeking a skilled AI Gateway Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with AI or API gateways, a strong background in backend development, and expertise in deploying and optimizing AI/ML models in a production environment. You will be instrumental in building and scaling our AI infrastructure within an enterprise-grade setting.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and manage AI/API gateways like Kong, Mosaic, or Portkey.
  • Develop and maintain backend services, primarily using Go , with Python as a valuable secondary skill.
  • Optimize and productize AI/ML models for production use, ensuring performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Leverage AWS to build and manage our cloud infrastructure.
  • Implement and manage observability tools, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), Grafana, and Prometheus , to monitor system health and performance.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of AI models.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and deployment of AI solutions.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Proven experience with API or AI gateways (e.g., Kong, Mosaic, Portkey).
  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Go ; proficiency in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with AI/ML optimization and productization .
  • Expertise in AWS , including its various services for building scalable applications.
  • Familiarity with observability tools like OTel, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Practical experience with prompt engineering .
  • A history of working in enterprise-grade environments .


Other Details:
  • Location: Remote (preferred in LATAM region)
  • Length: 1+ Year
  • Client: Gaming Giant

    • The difference between something good and something great is attention to detail – AVM Consulting.
